name: Heart of Pacific
source: Heart of Pacific is an adult visual novel in tropical setting and with the futuristic philosophy. 3 young women arrive to the artificial tropical island in the middle of the Pacific Ocean. The owner of the island is a famous technological genius and billionaire. He is about to present the world with something unprecedented.
translation: 《太平洋之心》是一部热带背景和未来主义哲学的成人视觉小说。3名年轻女性抵达太平洋中部的人工热带岛屿。这座岛的主人是一位著名的科技天才和亿万富翁。他即将向世界展示前所未有的东西。
